useful_behavior: Given a typed set of evidence items with provenance, claims, constraints, conflicts, confidence/uncertainty metadata, and a target question or decision, deterministically derive a terminal answer or decision, preserve unresolved conflicts and uncertainty, and emit an auditable inference/decision trace without any model dependency.
why_real_frontier_capability: The parent frontier capability requires combining evidence, resolving relevance/conflict, synthesizing a terminal answer, and deciding when evidence is sufficient to stop. This target isolates that real behavior rather than a benchmark predicate.

includes: evidence normalization after evidence has been acquired

evidence_for_selection: PR236 forbids any model in the credited cognition path
Brain already owns deterministic planning/discovery/execution/verification machinery; the remaining broad seam is evidence-to-terminal-decision cognition
promotion_bar: Two materially distinct real tasks must use the same model-independent synthesis route without rediscovery; outputs must be independently verified and the trace must make the decision reproducible.
residual_after_success: Arbitrary-language-to-structured-evidence interpretation and any other parent subcapabilities not yet independently acquired remain separate gaps.
